answer: Under EigenTrust-style factorization, reputation is derived from normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust links and transitive paths, then decays with an exponential half-life; sustained honest service is therefore needed to rebuild influence. A fresh sybil has no established incoming trust, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero and it cannot meet consensus thresholds. Even if identities wander through the network like a violet vine, splitting into many accounts does not create trusted weight.
